name: Room With a View
summary: An upstairs function room above a seafront pub, looking over the Exe.
description: Up a flight of stairs above the Grove's ground-floor pub, this function room looks straight out over the mouth of the River Exe. It is a flexible space — Young's, who run the pub, set it up for everything from wedding receptions and christenings to work away-days — and food ranges from a drinks-and-canapes reception through to a full sit-down meal.
